{{Quote|Flew two missions with Colonel, I mean General, Crespin's Comet Group and had to punch out or eat a bomber torpedo.|Garik Loran|<ref name="WS" />}}
The [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Comet Squadron]] was involved in a '''mission''' that took place in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. One of the squadron's [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star [[Garik Loran|Garik "Face" Loran]], was forced to eject during the operation to avoid a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]].
